title: apricity serve hands the web app a zipped DAW set for a saved score
description:
As a producer working in the web app, I want to download a DAW set of the score I'm editing, so that I can move to the DAW without the command line.

```gherkin
Feature: apricity serve hands out DAW sets
  Background:
    Given a library holding the score "blues" and the samples it plays

  Scenario: A saved score as a zipped set
    When I GET "/export/daw-set/blues" with the library's API key
    Then the status is 200 with "Content-Type: application/zip"
    And the zip holds "blues Project/blues.als" and the samples it plays under "blues Project/Samples/Imported/"
    And the set in the zip is the one "apricity export --daw-set" writes for the same score

  Scenario: The API key is required
    When I GET "/export/daw-set/blues" without an x-api-key header
    Then the status is 401

  Scenario: A score with mistakes
    Given the score "broken" has an unknown clip on line 4
    When I GET "/export/daw-set/broken" with the library's API key
    Then the status is 422
    And the JSON body lists the problem with line 4

  Scenario: An unknown score
    When I GET "/export/daw-set/nope" with the library's API key
    Then the status is 404 naming "nope"

  Scenario: Warnings travel with the set
    Given the score "lofi" has a setting with no stock equal
    When I GET "/export/daw-set/lofi" with the library's API key
    Then the status is 200
    And the response's warnings header lists that setting
```
